Supplies for diabetes and asthma clients may be covered from 80% up to 100%. Supplies for diabetes and asthma clients may be covered from 80% up to 100%. | Covered at 70%. |
| Routine Mammograms & Routine PAP testing | $5.00 copayment Pap only. | $10 copayment. If services are rendered with phy. office visit - covered in full. | Not Covered. |
| Routine vision exam | $5 copayment. One per year. | $10 copayment. One per year. | Not covered. |
| Wellness/Preventive (physical exams) & Immunizations | $5.00 copayment | $10 copayment for all ages. Immunizations are covered in full if rendered without visiting the phys. | Not Covered. |

Approval from Magellan is required. | Inpatient and outpatient substance abuse programs (limit of 2 per lifetime)- $10 copayment No annual day limit. Days must be pre-authorized. Approval from Magellan is required. | Inpatient and outpatient substance Abuse - $550 annually. No annual day limit. Days must be pre-authorized. Approval from Magellan is required. |
| Allergy Treatment | Testing & treatment - $5.00 copayment. Injections are covered in full if no office visit is charged. | Testing & treatment - $10 copayment. Injections are covered in full if no office visit is charged. | Covered at 70%. |
| Anesthesia | Covered in full. | Covered in full. | Covered at 70%. |
| Blood | Covered in full. | Covered in full. | Covered at 70%. |
| Chiropractor (Spinal manipulation services) | $5.00 copayment (limit 12 visits per year.) | $10 copay . (limit 12 visits per year.) | Covered at 70% (limit 12 visits per year combined with network.) |
| Durable | Covered at 80%. | Covered at 80%. | Covered at 70%. |
